description: This file defines the CaseConvert class, which provides static methods for converting string case: lower, upper, and proper case. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet calculation text data handling.

classes.name: CaseConvert
classes.description: A utility class providing string case conversion methods for the PhpSpreadsheet project.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to lowercase using StringHelper::strToLower.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to uppercase using StringHelper::strToUpper.

methods.name: proper
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to title case using StringHelper::strToTitle.
